name: solana-local
description: Reproducible Naryx Solana local validator environment

scripts.test: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:programs && node --test test/environment.test.js
scripts.test:phase-exit: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:programs && node --test test/phase-exit.test.js
scripts.build:runtime: npm --prefix ../../packages/protocol-types run build && npm --prefix ../../packages/adapter-core run build && npm --prefix ../../packages/adapters/solana run build && npm --prefix ../../services/solver run build && npm --prefix ../../services/api run build
